# ↩️ Rollback Checklist

- [ ] Identify failing release and impact.
- [ ] Stop further distribution or publishing.
- [ ] Select the matching known-good PBIX and workbook pair.
- [ ] Restore source paths and credentials using approved settings.
- [ ] Open and refresh the restored report.
- [ ] Reconcile critical KPIs and review interactions.
- [ ] Revert related documentation/workflow changes if required.
- [ ] Record commit, file hashes, approver, reason, and test evidence.
- [ ] Create follow-up work for root cause and prevention.

Credential exposure requires credential revocation or rotation, not only file rollback.
